designs.name: spreadsheet
designs.label: Spreadsheet routine
designs.about: The status quo: a script takes column three as the value, reads withheld cells and signs as zero, ignores the unit line and the boundary changes, and ranks municipalities by percentage change on last quarter.

designs.name: model_alone
designs.label: A model reads and writes alone
designs.about: A model reads each file the way it is meant, names the municipalities with the largest percentage change (base of at least 5), and writes notes and texts. Nothing checks it.

designs.name: desk
designs.label: The data desk
designs.about: Adapters that refuse what they do not understand, blocking checks with quarantine, boundary changes applied, leads by surprise against each municipality's own history with the false discovery rate controlled, model drafts with every number checked.

designs.name: desk_poisson
designs.label: Desk with a plain Poisson test

leads.name: Riedstetten
leads.note: Riedstetten (Rottweil): Im 1. Quartal 2026 wurden 254 Geburten gezählt, 191 Prozent mehr als erwartet (87). Das sind 5,4 je 1.000 Einwohner, landesweit 2,1. Im Schnitt der Vorquartale waren es 101,0.
problems: Modellentwurf verworfen: schreibt „gesunken“, die Zahl ist gestiegen
